name: Industrial ammonia synthesis begins
short_desc: The first industrial Haber–Bosch plant begins making ammonia, enabling large-scale production of synthetic nitrogen fertilizer.
date_note: The first industrial ammonia plant opened at Oppau on 9 September 1913. Haber’s laboratory work preceded it; industrial ammonia also supplied explosives.
notes: Added after a catalog gap review on 24 October 2026. A foundational change in the food system and chemical industry, distinct from the existing Fritz Haber biography. Evidence and date rationale: BASF’s first industrial ammonia synthesis plant opened at Oppau on 9 September 1913. This industrial milestone is distinct from Haber’s earlier laboratory work and later improvements; ammonia production also supplied explosives. Primary evidence: https://www.basf.com/global/de/who-we-are/history/Carl-Bosch. Cached Wikipedia introduction and lead image provide separately attributed background.
